verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਸਿਮਰ ਸਿਮਰ ਪ੍ਰਿਆ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਬਿਸਮ ਹੋਇ ਸੋਭਾ ਦੇਤ ਮੋਨ ਗਹੇ ਮਨ ਮੁਸਕਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise simar simar priaa prem ras bisam hoi sobhaa dhet mon gahe man musakaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a wife recalls her experience of pleasure with her husband and feels happy, becomes quiet and chuckles in her mind exhuming prettiness;

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਅਧਾਨ ਪਰਸੂਤ ਸਮੈ ਰੋਦਤ ਹੈ  ਗੁਰਜਨ ਮੁਦਤ ਹੁਇ ਤਾਹੀ ਲਪਟਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: pooran adhaan parasoot samai rodhat hai  gurajan mudhat hui taahee lapaTaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as on completion of her pregnancy, she goes into labour and cries due to pain but the elders of the house feel happy seeing the child and they shower love on him time and again;

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਮਾਨਵਤੀ ਮਾਨ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਕੈ ਅਮਾਨ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਪਾਇ ਚੁਪ ਹੁਲਸਾਤ ਗਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise maanavatee maan tiaag kai amaan hoi prem ras pai chup hulasaat gaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as an honoured pretty woman sheds her pride and arrogance and becomes humble, and on receipt of her husband's love when united with him becomes quiet and smiles within.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ ਜਾਸ ਬੋਲਤ ਬੈਰਾਗ ਮੋਨ ਗਹੈ ਬਹੁ ਸੁਹਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੬੦੫॥
verses.translit_en: taise gurmukh prem bhagat prakaas jaas bolat bairaag mon gahai bahu suhaat hai ||605||

en.bdb: Similarly, an obedient disciple of True Guru who experiences light divine as a result of his loving, perpetual meditation on Naam blessed by the Guru, he earns much respect and praise whether he speaks in a detached mood or goes silent in ecstasy.  (605)
